description: This file contains code for generating a dimension-wise accounts balance report in an ERP system, including functions for data retrieval, processing, and report formatting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, validating filters, retrieving dimension items, and generating columns and data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves account data, processes GL entries, and prepares report data based on filters and dimensions.

methods.name: set_gl_entries_by_account
methods.description: Fetches GL entries for each dimension item and associates them with accounts.

methods.name: format_gl_entries
methods.description: Formats GL entries and updates account data with dimension-specific values.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the final report data structure, aggregating account information and dimension values.

methods.name: accumulate_values_into_parents
methods.description: Accumulates child account values into parent accounts for hierarchical totals.

methods.name: get_condition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition string based on date and dimension filters.

methods.name: get_dimension_items_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of dimension items for the report based on the specified dimension and company.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report column definitions based on dimension items and company context.
